responsibilities: Translate stakeholder requirements into actionable insights
Develop data sets and dashboards that empower users to answer their questions and to support business decision making
Explain how to interpret and use data sets and dashboards in a straightforward way to various stakeholders
Convey enthusiasm about data to inspire and engage the organization
Leverage data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business growth
Stay up to date with innovative technologies in the field of data analytics and leverage them to drive impact

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, git and code reviews;
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: No speed or shipping language appears anywhere, while engineering-discipline signals like "Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, git and code reviews" and "creating standards for our work" carry the JD.
evidence.domain_risk: develops data driven solutions for our customers and customer processes
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The work supports consumer business decisions with no financial-reporting, audit or regulatory language, so "develops data driven solutions for our customers and customer processes" places it at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Analytics Translator; Data Scientists; Data- & Machine Learning Engineers from IT
evidence.data_team_maturity: The department is spread out in three business domain teams; where data experts and business collaborate closely to realize valuable data science solutions.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Three standing domain teams plus two named cross-cutting authorities show an established, specialised function rather than one being built.
evidence.jd_authorship: Translate stakeholder requirements into actionable insights
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Every responsibility bullet is interchangeable boilerplate with no tool, scale or method named, e.g. "Translate stakeholder requirements into actionable insights".
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Leverage data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business growth
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The audience is the consumer-facing business, framed as "opportunities for business growth" inside a Business to Consumer department.
evidence.autonomy_level: you know how to support our business by creating the right insights from data
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is framed as serving requests, "you know how to support our business by creating the right insights from data", with no direction-setting mandate.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Data scientists and ML engineers sit alongside the role, but nothing asks the candidate to use or build for AI.
evidence.testing_framing: Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, git and code reviews;
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Quality practice appears only as a line in the qualifications list, with no ownership verb attached anywhere in the responsibilities.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is written entirely in delivery and enthusiasm terms with no mention of risk, incidents or trust.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: You are an expert in adding new logic to it and in modelling this data in a way that enables users to answer their questions.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: New datasets and dashboards are built on an existing platform that the team also keeps improving, so both verbs are present.
evidence.urgency: We welcome your application in English, no later than, September 29th.
evidence.work_arrangement: At our company, hybrid working is the norm, meaning you will work at the office at least 50% of the time.
